1. You don’t have as many friends as you think

2. Money does buy happiness

3. If you’re retiring, pick up a social physical hobby

4. Mechanism of compounding now works heavily in your favor

5. Getting rich in a short period means you probably didn’t increase your cost of living. Be mindful of this.

6. Helping friends/fam is great but you cannot help people more than they’re willing to help themselves
